subject.title: [Feishu] Interactive Card message content parsing missing

question: What agent-visible payload contract should Feishu interactive cards use across direct inbound cards, card-action form/select callbacks, and merge_forward card sub-messages?
rationale: The direct inbound parser gap is source-reproducible, but exposing card text, full form/select fields, and callback payloads changes channel behavior that overlaps narrower open Feishu issues.

options.title: Coordinate Narrow Plugin Fixes
options.body: Keep this issue as the broad tracker, land direct inbound parser reuse in the Feishu plugin, and let narrower linked items define callback-field and merge_forward details.

options.title: Limit To Direct Inbound
options.body: Scope this issue to top-level inbound `interactive` message text extraction and leave callback and merge-forward payloads to their own issues.

options.title: Defer Full Payloads
options.body: Pause broad parsing until maintainers decide agents should not receive full Feishu card or form payloads beyond existing text extraction.

recommendation.title: Coordinate Narrow Plugin Fixes
recommendation.body: Keep this issue as the broad tracker, land direct inbound parser reuse in the Feishu plugin, and let narrower linked items define callback-field and merge_forward details.

likelyOwner.reason: The Feishu plugin metadata and docs name this handle as the community-maintained contact for the affected plugin.
